dataset_description: Corporate expense ledger for FY 2024 tracking all approved business expenditures across departments, vendors, and expense categories.
business_context: The finance team uses this data to monitor departmental spending against budgets, identify over-budget transactions, detect unusual vendor payments, and prepare quarterly expense reports for leadership.

expense_category.description: Type of expense (Travel, Software, Salaries, etc.)

approved_by.description: Manager ID who approved the expense

payment_method.description: How the expense was paid (Corporate Card, Wire Transfer, etc.)

budget_code.description: Internal budget code for cost centre allocation

over_budget.description: Whether this expense exceeded the allocated budget (Yes/No)

recurring.description: Whether this is a recurring expense (Yes/No)

quarter.description: Fiscal quarter in which the expense occurred
